lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is the Ouray joint session Monday where city and county leaders will hash out a proposed intergovernmental agreement to have the Sheriff's Office take over all law enforcement for the city starting January 2027 — public comment is on the agenda at 5:00 PM. Closer to home, Telluride Town Council meets Tuesday with a public hearing on a development vesting extension and a work session on automated license plate reader cameras, while the San Miguel County BOCC holds two public hearings Wednesday including one on fee waivers for Mountain Village's Ilium Valley affordable housing project.
